_comment: Unified revision-log schema. One schema, used by Phase 3 debugging, Phase 4 robustness logging, and the Phase 5 frontend 'X of Y claims revised' stat. Do not build a second logging system.
title: RevisionLogRow

revision_number.description: 0 = original claim before any revision. 1 = result of first revision. 2 = result of second revision.

after_claim.description: null is permitted when the claim is removed (revision_action = 'remove').

flag_reason.description: Free text in v0.1 — see open question below re: enum.

flag_severity.description: Captured for display only. Does NOT affect loop control — see loop_contract.md.

resolved.description: True if this specific flag was no longer present after the subsequent Critic evaluation.

final_status.description: Terminal status for this claim once the run ends.

_run_level_outcome_comment: The run-level summary object below is derived FROM this log, not maintained independently. The frontend's 'X of Y claims revised' stat must be computed from revision-log rows, not a separate counter.

_derivation_rules.claims_total: count(distinct claim_id in final synthesis draft)
_derivation_rules.claims_revised: count(distinct claim_id where at least one row has revision_number > 0)

_open_question: flag_reason is currently free text (mirrors Critic's 'reason' field in critic_to_synthesis.json). If a Phase 6 breakdown by reason type (unsupported / overstated / contradicted / missing_citation) is wanted for the writeup, lock this to an enum before Phase 3. Currently unconfirmed — flagging so it isn't missed.
